nodes.label: Architecte / Tech Lead (role)
nodes.rationale: Coordinator and principal integrator; sizes tasks (S/M/L), splits work, fixes shared contracts before parallel work, never self-validates its own transversal edits.

nodes.label: Product / Business Analyst (role)
nodes.rationale: Turns a decided need into a testable spec; cannot invent a business rule — places ambiguous specs in Needs Decision instead.

nodes.label: Frontend / UX (role)
nodes.rationale: Owns frontend/ by default; never starts an interface without an approved Figma mockup — task becomes Blocked — Design Required otherwise.

nodes.label: Backend (role)
nodes.rationale: Owns backend/ by default except modules delegated to AI/RAG or MCP/Security specialists for the current task.

nodes.label: IA / RAG / Knowledge Graph (role)
nodes.rationale: For the MVP, must stay within the PostgreSQL/pgvector architecture decision; cannot introduce Neo4j or new data infrastructure without project-owner approval.

nodes.label: MCP / IAM / Sécurité (role)
nodes.rationale: Can block a delivery that bypasses a permission, approval, or non-negotiable project principle; agents never see raw secret values, only injected connectors.

nodes.label: QA / Test Automation (role)
nodes.rationale: Renders an independent, verifiable verdict; the agent that developed a task can never declare it done alone.

nodes.label: DevOps / SRE (role)
nodes.rationale: Only an explicit order from the project owner authorizes a production deployment.

nodes.label: Notion bases (Specs/Tasks/Decisions/Development Log)
nodes.rationale: Notion coordinates development only; Jira/Confluence/Figma remain the product's business systems and their content must never be copied into Notion as a coordination tool.

nodes.label: Definition of Done (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: A task is mergeable only when acceptance criteria, approved mockups, shared contracts, validated I/O, passing tests, security review, an independent QA verdict, updated durable docs, and a filled Development Log all hold simultaneously.
